'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=莉莉贝}} is a Priestess [[NPC]] found praying at the entrance of Tetragon Temple. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:(Under the hands of a Priestess, even a blank wall may transform with quiet revelation.)

:(But the Priestess averts her eyes from the flickering flames or fate, as if one more look will burn her.)

:She trembles. She cannot bear to look. She cannot bring herself to paint.)

:{{DIcon}} Murals don't paint themselves.

:'''Maeve:''' I'm afraid of seeing too clearly. Once I see fate's full shape, I might never escape that future.

:'''Maeve:''' And if I falter or lose my way... what will happen to those who look to me for guidance?

:'''Maeve:''' Grandmother Lillibet once said, "Know your fate, and prepare for it. Only then can we find firm ground on the path it takes us."

:'''Maeve:''' It's okay... as long as I remember that, I won't be lost.
{{Dialogue End}}
